title: Production Model API with Tests & Drift Monitoring
blurb: Wrap a trained model in a validated, tested, containerized API that watches for drift.
brief: Take any model you trained earlier and ship it properly. Expose it behind an HTTP API with input validation, a health endpoint and structured logging. Write unit, model and API tests, containerize the service, and add a drift monitor that compares live feature distributions against the training data (PSI or a KS test) and exposes the result. Include a load-test or latency measurement and a rollback note in the README.
requirements: A web API (Flask or FastAPI) with a predict endpoint and a health endpoint
Request validation that rejects malformed or out-of-range inputs with clear errors
Model loading at startup from a versioned artifact (without unpickling untrusted data)
Structured logging of requests, latency and errors
Tests for the preprocessing, the model behavior and the API contract
A drift check (PSI or KS) between training data and recent requests
A Dockerfile and a README covering run, test and rollback
deliverables: A script demonstrating drift detection on shifted data
stretch: A CI workflow that runs the tests
resume_bullet: Deployed an ML model as a validated, containerized API with automated tests, structured logging and PSI-based drift monitoring.
